does: Removes the hypothetical position the AI assumed for an entity, putting a character back where it really is.

evidence.says: finds the entity in the override map at +0x31C/+0x320, and for an esv::Character calls +0x35E35E0 to restore it
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 5 places
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
